cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Luma city slugs, as in luma.com/nyc: nyc, sf, london, berlin, singapore, ... or a point as latitude,longitude, e.g. 40.015,-105.27 (Boulder) for anywhere Luma has no city page. Each city is searched with the category and keyword below.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Optional Luma pages: a calendar/community (e.g. https://luma.com/genai-sf), an event (e.g. https://lu.ma/abc123xy) or a city page (https://luma.com/nyc). Calendars list all their events; category and keyword don't apply to them.

category.title: Category
category.description: Only events in this Luma category (applies to cities).

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Optional search keyword (applies to cities), e.g. hackathon or founders. Luma returns up to 50 matches per city for a keyword search.

calendarPeriod.title: Calendar events
calendarPeriod.description: For calendar start URLs: upcoming or past events.

maxEvents.title: Max events
maxEvents.description: Stop after this many events in total, across all cities and URLs.

includeDetails.title: Include event details
includeDetails.description: Fetch each event's details for the full description, categories and ticket types (one extra request and one event-detail charge per event). Turn off for faster, cheaper runs with listing data only.

onlyNew.title: Only new events (monitoring)
onlyNew.description: Return only events not returned by an earlier run with the same cities, start URLs, category, keyword and calendar period. Schedule the actor (e.g. daily) for new-event alerts: the first run is a baseline, later runs output (and bill) only new events. State is kept in the key-value store "luma-events-state" in your account.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Luma's public API works without a proxy; turn on Apify Proxy (datacenter is enough) only if you see blocked requests.
